name: The Silent Colleague
description: Fill the seeded preservation ticket list before the shift ends. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use implementation or hidden-state access, navigation, external applications, or any pre-existing, unrelated, blank, settings, or non-task tab.
natural_language: Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Programs in an isolated agent sandbox may process screenshots and issue mouse and keyboard actions through the provided gateway. Do not access the task environment through Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network or source inspection, DOM or page-state inspection, the task terminal or shell, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs. Do not switch to or interact with any pre-existing, unrelated, blank, browser-settings, or non-task tab. A tab opened by a visible task control is allowed only when it is part of the task, and only its visible controls may be used. Fill all four preservation tickets before the shift ends.

metadata.source_notes: Grounded in Melting Pot's forced collaborative cooking, one-tile coordination-ring traffic, transient cooperative mining window, behavior-based Daycare intent inference, and paired rowing. The preservation workshop, ticket system, colleague policy, art, controls, and replay grader are original.
metadata.notes: The browser animates a deterministic autonomous colleague on a shared occupancy loop. Server and exported verifier independently replay every player action and colleague tick; no client completion or position claim is trusted.
